_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System Security Administrator Operators Documentation (SSAOD)
summary: The SSAOD provides format and content instructions for contractor-developed documentation covering audit, archive, and anti-cyber warfare operating procedures to be integrated into a government OPSEC training manual.
use_relationship:
The SSAOD developed by the contractor will be integrated into a baseline OPSEC training manual by the government to train the audit and archive procedures and the operation of the anti-cyber warfare capabilities provided in the delivered system.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The System Security Administrator Operators Documentation shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figures 1 and 2.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The System Security Administrator Operators Documentation shall contain Appendixes "A" through "E".

children.title: Appendix A shall identify:
Clearing IA Alarms
Appendix A.2 shall identify Diagnosing IA Alarms
Appendix A.3 shall identify Generating an Incident Report Summary
Appendix "B" shall include Changing Passwords:
Appendix B.1 shall identify changing passwords on workstation consoles
Appendix B.2 shall identify changing password procedures for rack mounted cpus
Appendix B.3 shall identify changing password procedures for the automated status board
Appendix B.6 shall identify changing password procedures for network devices
Appendix B.7 shall identify changing file integrity checker passphrases
Appendix B.8 shall identify changing file integrity checker passphrase
Appendix B.9 shall identify changing audit tool password
Appendix B.9.1 shall identify changing audit tool password for security administrator
Appendix B.9.1 shall identify changing audit tool password for system administrator
Appendix "C" shall be entitled Conduct System Audit.
children.content: This appendix shall specify procedures to identify system misuse and hacker threat attacks. It shall detail what action should be taken if a security violation is found. This appendix shall also include the procedures to identify the following auditable items from the contractor's delivered system:

children.title: List of Hostnames Included in the audit report
List of Hostnames not Included in the audit report
Alphabetical list of authorized usernames
Chronological list of successful login attempts organized by Information System (IS)
Chronological list of failed login attempts organized by IS
Chronological list of successful sulog attempts organized by IS
Chronological list of failed sulog attempts organized by IS
Chronological list of alerts from the Intrusion Detection System (IDS)/Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) organized by IS
Chronological list of file monitor alerts organized by IS
Chronological list of system status
Chronological list of successful root login attempts organized by IS
Chronological list of root login attempts organized by IS
Chronological list of user additions or deletions organized by IS
Chronological list of password change attempts, both successful and unsuccessful organized by IS
Chronological list of router/switch login attempts, both successful and unsuccessful organized by IS
Chronological list of enable router/switch login, both successful and unsuccessful organized by IS
Appendix "D" shall be entitled "Archive Security Logs".
children.content: This appendix shall provide procedures to archive audit logs to removable backup media that will be stowed in a GSA-approved security container. This appendix shall include warnings to users that security audit logs and reports shall be kept for one year. This appendix shall also include warnings to users that record destruction shall be specified.

children.title: Appendix "E" shall include procedures generating the Formal Incident Report.
children.content: This appendix shall provide the procedures for reporting and documenting a computer security incident on DoD computer equipment to the Navy Cyber Defense Operations Command (NCDOC), the In-Service Engineering Agent, Program office and its support activities. This appendix shall include the procedures for crew submittal of an OPREP3. This appendix shall also specify the procedures to be used for reporting incident details after the OPREP-3 is sent.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements:
preparation_instructions.content: The SSAOA electronic media shall be Microsoft Word Version 2003-2007.
